positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: FOMC (7/28-29) is the dominant binary catalyst for the entire complex, and the setup turned more hawkish: CME FedWatch now prices a 35.8% chance of a rate HIKE (up from 25.7% a week ago), the hardest Fed meeting to call in years. Risk appetite is defensive — Crypto Fear & Greed sits in 'fear,' BTC slid ~2.5% from ~$65k toward ~$63.9k and ETH -3.2% at the open. On a low-edge, macro-binary, risk-off day, BTC pairs the deepest liquidity and lowest beta with the best downside protection in the universe.
positions.driver: Closed prior BTC at 63894.60 (canonical live proxy, asOf 2026-07-29T02:57Z) for -$88.74 (entry 64432.11). Re-selected BTC as the best risk-adjusted next-24h setup into a hawkish binary FOMC. Wins vs runners-up: ETH (~1909) is firming on a record staking ratio and showed relative strength, but is higher-beta and would be hit hardest on a hawkish surprise; SOL (~73.7) and XRP (~1.08) had only modest weekly inflows and no fresh idiosyncratic catalyst. With hike odds rising, BTC's low beta + 8% major stop gives the cleanest asymmetric payoff with the most downside protection ahead of the Fed.
positions.risks: FOMC 7/28-29 is a binary macro risk with rising hike odds (35.8%): a hawkish hold/hike, higher Treasury yields, or renewed inflation/tariff fears could pressure the whole complex; sentiment is already in 'fear' and ETF flows have been mixed. A decisive break below ~$62.5k would signal the pre-Fed bid is unwinding. Hard stop 58783.03 (-8%, majors rule) caps downside while leaving room below near-term support.
